function: p. 7-8: DRL agents (UAV or BS) jointly choose beamforming vectors, RIS phase shifts, NOMA power gains and UAV 3-D placement to maximize energy efficiency.
system: p. 5, 7, 12: multi-UAV-mounted BS (16 antennas) with 16-element passive RIS, or ground BS (16 antennas) with UAV-mounted RIS; single-antenna users, NOMA, 28 GHz.
method: p. 8: model-free DQN, DDQN, DDPG, TD3 and model-based MBPO deep reinforcement learning; state is last received SINR, reward is energy efficiency minus constraint penalties.
data_channel: p. 5-6, 12: simulated Rician channels with LoS and Rayleigh NLoS parts (Eqs. 1-3), 28 GHz, path-loss exponent 2.2, Rician factor 10 dB; no dataset or measurements.
test_conditions: p. 5, 9-12: users and RIS at fixed locations; results for perfect versus imperfect SIC and 4 to 64 antennas; no unseen-condition test stated.
baselines: p. 8-9, 12-13: learned DQN, DDQN, DDPG, TD3 against MBPO (Table II); non-learned iterative algorithm of [43] (Fig. 14); NOMA against SDMA and OMA.
metrics: p. 8-13: mean spectral efficiency (bits/s/Hz) and energy efficiency (bits/s/Hz/J), CDFs of both, SE versus number of antennas, training episodes to convergence (Table V).
complexity: none: p. 12 Table V gives only episodes to convergence (MBPO 5704, DQN 841 for the BS scenario); no complexity order, operations, parameter count or runtime.
openness: none: p. 9 only says a table summarizes simulation parameters for reproducibility; no code or data link or DOI.
q1_support: p. 5: "Rician fading model, which captures the hybrid propagation" - custom Rician LoS plus Rayleigh NLoS model (Eqs. 1-3) with Table III parameters (p. 12); no 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 5: "locations of the g-UEs and the RIS are fixed" - fixed scenario; Figs. 8 and 13 (p. 10, 12) only vary the number of transmit antennas, with no statement that a trained agent is tested on an unseen configuration, and no fine-tuning or transfer.
q3_support: p. 12: "Fig. 14 compares the proposed MBPO algorithm with an iterative algorithm from [43]" (non-learned, on EE); p. 8: "employ DQN, DDQN, DDPG, TD3, and MBPO algorithms", with SE and EE compared in Table II and Figs. 4-5, 9-10 (learned).
q4_support: p. 12: "Table V presents empirical results on the number of" episodes required for convergence - no complexity order, operations, parameter count or runtime; the surrounding complexity text is qualitative.
q5_support: p. 9: "Table II summarizes the simulation" parameters for reproducibility, but no code or data link or DOI is given; channels are simulated (p. 5) and no public dataset is used.
notes: Included, area 6: learned beams, power, RIS phases and UAV placement on UAV aerial links (UAV-mounted BS and UAV-mounted RIS); by the specificity order of Step 2 area 6 wins over area 3, which would be the answer by function alone.
